item.text: {"search_note":"The clearest 2024 pattern is restraint + communication: Vietnam repeatedly used official statements to cool territorial and regional crises. The strongest concrete channel-preservation evidence is the Vietnam-Philippines coastguard/security cooperation and Vietnam’s offer to talk after the UN maritime claim. I found no reliable 2024 evidence of Trọng using a crisis to escalate or to break communication channels. The main caveat is attribution: much of the evidence is state diplomacy under Trọng’s legacy, especially after mid-July, not direct personal crisis messaging from Trọng himself.","evidence":[{"title":"Vietnam urges respect of international law as China draws Gulf of Tonkin baseline","publisher":"Reuters","date":"2024-03-14","url":"https://www.reuters.com/world/asia-pacific/vietnam-urges-respect-international-law-china-draws-gulf-tonkin-baseline-2024-03-14/","summary":"Vietnam’s foreign ministry responded to China’s Gulf of Tonkin baseline move by stressing international law and the rights/interests of other states.
